verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes a unified candidate profile that combines resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history and consent status in one record. It only shows scattered API endpoints: candidate creation, a rating endpoint, an offer endpoint and an events collection. These are developer building blocks, not documented evidence of the single-record profile the story asks for.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record
